summary: Learn synthetic data generation for analytics and AI training with practical validation, governance, and delivery tools.
lede: Synthetic data generation creates artificial datasets for analytics and AI training when real data is limited, sensitive, or incomplete. This course is for data and governance professionals who need to prepare usable datasets, with practical work in profiling source data, choosing statistical or model-based methods, validating utility and privacy risks, and documenting synthetic data for review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to create, validate, govern, or consume synthetic data in analytics and AI training workflows.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of analytics or data science workflows, basic statistics, and familiarity with tabular datasets. You should be comfortable reading data profiles, using spreadsheet-based analysis or Python notebooks, and discussing privacy concepts such as masking and re-identification risk. No production coding is required, but prior exposure to pandas, Jupyter Notebook, or similar analysis tools will help you move faster. Advanced synthetic generation concepts are covered at an operational level, not as technical engineering for model deployment.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
